newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Gaming says product sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Gaming says product sales rise.

text.p: Advanced Gaming Technology Inc on Wednesday said its new MAX BINGO computerized gaming systems continue to generate new sales with some 2,165 units either installed or on backlog.
In a statement, the company said 685 installed units are generating $145,000 a month. Another 385 units will soon begin operations, boosting total revenues to $225,000 a month.
In addition, a backlog of about 1,100 units should generate sales of $215,000 per month once they are installed.
Finally, the company said its numbers exclude 1,000 units set for installation in Oklahoma in 1997's third quarter.
